headline: Up Your Arsenal advances multiplayer-menu matching as the launcher gains bloom and lighting fixes
summary: Up Your Arsenal's PAL v1.00 rose from 19.84% to 21.64% of matched code as multiplayer-menu matching landed. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Launcher development brought bloom, lighting fixes for edited levels and Mod SDK 1.14.5 (OpenRAC#407, OpenRAC#433, OpenRAC#438). All four decompilations shortened their READMEs and organised their detailed documentation. Wrench Throw 1.0.1 was approved for the launcher index, while 1.0.2 still awaited review (openrac-mods#154, openrac-mods#155).
